subject: Fold BonfyreTier latency observations into ResourceWeather and routing without a second scheduler

body.text: BonfyreTier is a useful named Power but its legacy tier.db owns static instant/fast/batch/deep thresholds, assignments and latency observations while bonfyre-control/economy consult it for routing. Converge this with the mature PhysicalExecutionFrame, ResourceWeather, ProviderGraph and ConstraintIR rather than reviving tier.db as routing authority. Preserve Tier as an SLA/latency policy and observation surface: measured latency becomes a typed realization/resource observation; an SLA or user deadline is a constraint/agreement; current route selection remains with existing convergence/provider owners. Static tier names can remain projections/presets, not physical truth. Tie tier observations to the same UsageOccurrence/attempt identities now entering finance so one execution has one wall-time fact. Then use the data as an adaptive communication prior: low-latency deterministic queries may favor semantic refs/digests, while expensive deep proof is reserved for high-entropy residue. This is advisory density selection, not a new scheduler.
